name: New Moon
overview: The New Moon in Scripture is marked as a significant time for solemn worship and offerings to the LORD, as detailed in Numbers 10:10 and Numbers 28:11-15. It is a feast day when specific burnt offerings, including young bullocks, rams, and lambs, are presented alongside their accompanying grain and drink offerings, symbolizing a sweet savor to God. The blowing of trumpets signals these sacred observances, serving as a memorial before God. Additionally, the period of the New Moon involved a suspension of ordinary activities such as traffic, emphasizing the holiness and rest dedicated to the LORD during this time.
